task_text: IKEA MuJoCo LACK side table (IKEA LACK side table (AA-207276-4, four legs)) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Screw all four legs onto the four threaded studs of the tabletop. Success requirements: The tabletop lies studs up. Each leg (nut end down) is screwed onto a stud; any leg may go on any stud, one leg per stud. Every leg is seated and latched on a distinct stud, and at the end, measured in the tabletop frame: the leg origin is 0 to 12 mm above the slab top, within 20 mm laterally of its stud, and the leg axis is within 10 degrees of the tabletop axis. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: The M16 x 2 right-hand threads are exact convex pieces: a leg advances only by being turned (about six turns from first thread contact to the seat). A leg that is seated on a vacant stud and descends slower than 0.05 m/s is latched to the tabletop at its current pose (a weld, the source's fixed joint).
